Extract Dublin Core metadata tags

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle options_handle = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{\"extract_metadata\":true}");
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<html><head><title>Scholarly Work</title><meta name=\"DC.title\" content=\"Principles of Knowledge Management\"><meta name=\"DC.creator\" content=\"Dr. Alice Johnson\"><meta name=\"DC.date\" content=\"2023-06-15\"><meta name=\"DC.subject\" content=\"Knowledge Management\"><meta name=\"DC.publisher\" content=\"Academic Press\"></head><body><p>This is a scholarly article.</p></body></html>", options_handle);
    htm_conversion_options_free(options_handle);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
